current_checkpoint_note: GPS Job Mode / Uber-style Activity Recording campaign (starting SHA efd0a9e, the prior Supports Intelligence + Farm Strategy phase's own closing commit -- treated as a closed checkpoint, not reopened) -- Phase 1 (Contracts and state machine) complete: src/domain/gps-activity-detection.ts, two pure, dependency-free, independently-tested detectors (advanceStartDetection searches every mapped field for genuine dwelling evidence; advanceFinishDetection watches an already-known active field for genuine departure), reusing near-field.ts's distanceToPolygonKm and weather-stations.ts's haversineDistanceKm directly. 15 new tests exercise the campaign brief's own Scenarios A-D (sustained dwelling, drive-past x2, boundary jitter, two-adjacent-fields) plus accuracy fail-closed behaviour, terminal-state no-op, and genuinely tiered confidence. Pre-existing architecture confirmed by direct inspection and deliberately not reopened: the full reactive GPS Job Session + Confirm Actual contract (docs/product/farm-return-next-v1.1/GPS_JOB_SESSION_ACTUAL_CONTRACT.md) already ships a real job_sessions lifecycle, job_actuals fertiliser_spreading validator, LocationTrackingProvider capability boundary, and manual Start/Active/Finish/Confirm UI -- this campaign adds only the proactive automatic-detection half. job_sessions.origin already accepts 'detected' at the database level; no migration needed for that. No real persisted planned-fertiliser-application data exists (mock-only, confirmed by inspection) -- fertiliser spreading proceeds as the first vertical regardless, per the campaign brief's own 'do not fabricate missing plan data' instruction (Confirm Actual already requires manual product/quantity entry either way). Quality gate: 1619/1619 tests (127/127 files), typecheck/lint/build all pass, up from 1604/1604 (126/126) -- no test weakened. Phase 2/3 also complete: gps-activity-candidate-controller.ts wires Farm Awareness (startFarmAwareness -- unused by any caller anywhere in this app until now) to the pure detector; startManualJobSession additively extended with origin/deviceMetadata passthrough (both already-existing, already-persisted job_sessions fields -- no migration needed). Phase 3's own persistence/recovery requirements are, for the reactive/confirmed half of this feature, already fully satisfied by the pre-existing GPS Job Session + Confirm Actual contract. 7 new tests. Phase 4/5 also complete: GpsActivityCandidateCard.tsx (the Before/Start moment, wired into Today) renders only once real, sustained dwelling evidence exists, assumes fertiliser_spreading (the one activity type with a complete Confirm Actual flow -- disclosed, not silently narrowed), confirms via the existing startManualJobSessionAction with origin:'detected' + real deviceMetadata, navigates straight to the existing /job/[id] screen unmodified. ActiveJobSessionView.tsx (the End moment) now also advances advanceFinishDetection against the same real position stream Active Tracking already receives, surfacing a suggestion-only 'Looks like you finished' line above the existing Finish button -- never automatic, fails closed with no known primary field. 7 new tests. The full behavioural loop is real, end to end: real (or simulated) GPS samples -> candidate detection -> farmer confirm -> real job_sessions row -> real Active Tracking (unchanged, already-audited) -> finish suggestion -> farmer taps Finish (unchanged) -> real Confirm Actual (unchanged) -> real job_actuals row. Next: Phase 6 (simulation/ end-to-end verification recap + Codex audit loop). Round 5 fixes now in: advanceFinishDetection uses a new three-way classifyFieldMembership (inside/outside/ambiguous) instead of a bare confidently-inside check, so ambiguous (poor-accuracy, near-boundary) fixes are never treated as departure evidence and an unmatched activeFieldId fails closed; the orchestration deviceMetadata validator and the domain module's own sample gate both now reuse isValidIsoUtcDateTime instead of a lenient Date parse, and the sample gate (isUsableSample, renamed from hasUsableAccuracy) also validates lat/lng range. Next: Codex audit round 6. Round 6 fixes now in: advanceFinishDetection's departure window is now anchored to the first genuine 'outside' sample (firstGenuineOutsideAt), reset only on a genuine 'inside' confirmation and untouched by an ambiguous sample in between, with a hard requirement that the current sample itself classify as 'outside' before the duration/count check fires -- closing a gap where real clock time passing through a run of merely ambiguous fixes after earlier genuine outside evidence could otherwise cross the threshold. gps-activity-candidate-controller.ts's start()/stop() race (a stop() arriving while start() awaits the provider could leave a live subscription running past the caller's own stop()) is fixed via a shared in-flight start promise and a stopRequestedDuringStart flag honoured the moment start() knows its own outcome. Next: Codex audit round 7. Round 7 fixes now in (0 Critical/High -- first round to clear the BUILD_PLAN.md gate outright; 2 Medium fixed anyway): the controller's stopRequestedDuringStart flag no longer leaks into a later successful start() when an in-flight attempt that requested it never actually installed a subscription; job/[id]/page.tsx now gives ActiveJobSessionView a real key={id} on every return path so two different job sessions are never reconciled onto the same stale component instance (the finish-detection reset identity inside the component also now includes session.id as defence in depth). Next: Codex audit round 8 to confirm closure. Round 8 fixes now in: firstGenuineOutsideAt now also resets to null on an ambiguous sample (round 6 had left it untouched), closing a gap where two sparse outside fixes bridged by a long ambiguous gap could satisfy the duration/count thresholds on non-continuous evidence -- sustained departure now requires a genuinely unbroken run of outside samples. GpsActivityCandidateCard.tsx's periodic permission re-check now handles a rejected getCapability() explicitly instead of leaving an unhandled rejection every 15s. Next: Codex audit round 9. Round 9 fixes now in: new maxSampleGapSecondsForContinuity (120s) config closes two continuity gaps -- the start detector now drops a candidate entirely on a stable, sustained departure (not just a switch to a different real field), and both detectors reset their own evidence anchor across a real gap between consecutive accepted samples (an app interruption/suspension/signal loss), so neither a return visit nor a silent data gap can combine with earlier evidence as if it were continuous. Next: Codex audit round 10.
